topic: Do You Need a Business Plan to Get Finance?
objective: Clarify when a formal business plan is and isn't required for finance.

slides.headline: Do You Need a Business Plan to Get Finance?
slides.subheadline: Not always required — but rarely wasted effort.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: For many straightforward business loans, a full formal business plan isn't required — trading history and financials do most of the talking. For start-ups, larger facilities, or more complex lending, though, a clear plan showing how funds will be used and repaid can meaningfully support an application.

caption:
It's a common assumption that every loan application needs a formal business plan — in practice, many established businesses are assessed primarily on trading history and financials instead.

Where a plan does help is for start-ups without trading history, or for larger and more complex facilities, where lenders want to see a clear picture of how funds will be used and repaid.
